lines: I want to strip everything away!
Hide nothing, wrap nothing up—put it all into words
But the moment I open my mouth someone's bound to get hurt, so I can't say it!
I'm so afraid of saying anything, even to myself, that before I know it I'm talking to myself—lonely-na!
